entries.title: I kept them shut
entries.body:
I shook the dust out of my coat. The bull beside me got up and shook his into it.

Waited with my eyes shut. I could hear another one getting up. I kept them shut.

entries.visibleScene: A large bison stands broadside in suspended, backlit dust among several reclining bison in a grassy field. Other bison are visible farther back. Dark foreground bodies contrast with warm dust; distant human structures are visible.
entries.fictionBoundary: Oswin identity, neighboring bulls' sex, who raised each part of the dust, individual shakes, getting up in sequence, closed eyes, hearing and anticipation are invented. The still shows the herd, standing/reclining contrast and dust, not the full sequence or a specific eye state.
entries.imageReview: Original and source-published 1300x867 Large delivery individually opened before literal prose. Warm backlit dust is distinct and luminous, foreground silhouettes legible; faces are dark rather than artificially brightened. No crop or image modification.
entries.distinctness: A neighboring animal extends the consequence of the narrator's action. This does not repeat sign scratching, a traction contest, food retrieval, advice rejection, climbing or holding still to support a sleeper. Prose is intentionally a brief comic sequence; lead may hold if the payoff is too slight.

canon.continuity: Append within adult chronology after admitted newborn memory, sign scratching and bull pressure contest. No change to approved prose, profile, portrait, mates or offspring. Unnamed neighboring bulls already belong to Oswin's canon.
canon.voice: Short physical declarations. The new consequence is one animal's dust removal being prolonged by the next animal, ending with Oswin anticipating another cloud. No audience humiliation or claims that others copy or ridicule him.

biologicalSource.supportedClaims: Bison roll in dry dirt for dust bathing; it can occur in a social setting. No precise medicinal, mating, communication or behavioral-trigger claim used.

canon.spentIfAdmitted: Sequential dust clouds from neighboring animals force the narrator to keep waiting with eyes shut. Do not turn later bison scenes into repeated dust/itch complaints.
canon.newRelationships: None named. No hostile bull carried over from the earlier contest and no permanent cooperation inferred.

Neither supplies a developed episode without offscreen action doing too much work.
